entities.summary: An aula regia, also referred to as a palas hall, is a name given to the great hall in an imperial palace in the Ancient Roman architecture and in the derived medieval audience halls of emperors, kings or bishops as part of their palaces. In the Middle Ages the term was also used as a synonym for the Pfalz (palace) itself.
